goal: Fresh independent architecture advise of add-household-trust-contract. First read only proposal.md Why, living-spec rules and cited existing source; write a ten-line independent take before opening design.md, tasks.md and the delta. Then compare and write reviews/2026-09-15-advise.md with ADVISE accept or send-back, READER and SPAWN provenance. This is contract-only, not runtime acceptance. Be rigorous about owner/issuer/holder separation, recovery, revocation, reboot/time, physical proof and API-contract gaps that must be resolved before dependent implementations. If a material human decision is required, identify it explicitly. Project requires beads tracking: put blocking findings in your review rather than adding markdown task checkboxes; conductor records them in beads. Work inside conductor-workers boundary: edit declared paths and return for conductor persistence.

anchors.invariant: Read Why first, before proposed design.
Proposed requirements are not evidence of built runtime.
Existing proposal separates self-service name authority from protected node operations; not a shipped capability.
Existing public portal does not establish owner authority.

acceptance.if_true: Contract cleanly distinguishes a valid narrower owner-authorized operation from membership, altered-holder, untrusted-issuer, stale-authority and replay attempts, with honest implementation boundaries.
acceptance.if_false: Review identifies concrete missing constraints or contradictions that prevent using this as the downstream trust contract.

out_of_scope.item: runtime implementation and live node access
